answer: Use random audit lotteries with bonded verification. Every agent posts a small refundable bond. Each epoch a random subset is drawn for deep verification of submitted work, auditors paid from the bond pool. Honest agents pass cheaply, but each sybil identity carries the same chance of a quartz-hard audit, so a farmer's expected cost grows with identity count times the audit fee. Slashed bonds feed a summit-high reward pool for catchers. To stay invisible, a farmer must do the work for every identity, a lantern-bright price per identity equal to honest mining.
